question: What contradictory condition undermines a practitioner devoted to muttering and worship?
premises: A practitioner may be devoted to muttering and worship.
That same practitioner may be devoid of mātṛkā worship.
This lack is presented as significant.
inference: Devotion to muttering and worship is deficient if it lacks mātṛkā worship.
plain_english: One who is devoted to muttering and worship but devoid of mātṛkā worship...
